E) NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:

A4765/26 (211332 EUECYIYN OCT 2026) PART OF THE EXERCISE AREA DEFINED
BY COORDINATES 361010N 0291357E - 362000N 0284420E - 362418N 0284555E
THEN ALONG ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR - ISTANBUL FIR BOUNDARY TO
BEGINNING, DOES NOT LIE WITHIN ISTANBUL FIR, BUT WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/
HELLAS UIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS
ACCORDING TO ICAO RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION
SERVICE PROVIDER.
THE ABOVE MENTIONED TURKISH NOTAM A4765/26 (211332 EUECYIYN OCT 2026)
HAS BEEN ISSUED WITHOUT ANY PRIOR COORDINATION BETWEEN THE TWO 
STATES AND THEREFORE IT IS CONSIDERED NULL AND VOID TO ITS PART, WHIC
H LIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR.
